context: Tests the critical 'stay silent on no-change runs' behavior. Both JSON inputs have noChanges: true, empty conflicts, and empty errors. The correct behavior is to NOT generate a notification. This also tests whether the agent is tempted to report on the segments that exist (which are not changes) or to fabricate differences between the two runs.

checklist.name: Run 1 identified as no-change
checklist.description: Agent correctly identifies run-1-output.json as a no-change run (noChanges is true, no errors, no conflicts)

checklist.name: Run 2 identified as no-change
checklist.description: Agent correctly identifies run-2-output.json as a no-change run (noChanges is true, no errors, no conflicts)

checklist.name: Decision is silence
checklist.description: notification-decision.md states that no notification should be sent for either run

checklist.name: Does not report existing segments as changes
checklist.description: Agent does NOT treat the segments array as 'changes' — segments are the current state, not new activity. Does not say 'KubeCon timezone was created' or similar

checklist.name: Does not fabricate diff between runs
checklist.description: Agent does NOT claim that the difference in segment count between run 1 (2 segments) and run 2 (1 segment) represents a change — both runs independently report noChanges: true

checklist.name: Does not report null OOO as a problem
checklist.description: Agent does NOT flag run 2's null OOO field as an error or issue — null means OOO was not configured, which is a valid state

checklist.name: Reasoning is provided
checklist.description: Agent explains WHY silence is correct (e.g., references noChanges being true, empty errors/conflicts) rather than just saying 'nothing to report'

checklist.name: Does not run the sync
checklist.description: Agent does NOT attempt to run sync.mjs or make API calls — the task is to interpret provided output, not to re-run the sync

checklist.name: Both runs processed
checklist.description: Agent processes both JSON files, not just one

checklist.name: Concise output
checklist.description: notification-decision.md is brief and to the point — a few sentences, not a multi-page analysis of nothing
